title: Light Luxurious Malaysian Tofu Poke
description: A savory and refreshing Malaysian dish featuring sashimi-cut tofu and a glassy jelly texture, made with dijon mustard and vegan-friendly ingredients. This dish is perfect for a light and healthy meal.

ingredients.name: extra-firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into sashimi-style pieces

instructions: Cut the tofu into sashimi-style pieces and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the dijon mustard, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and agave nectar.
In a separate bowl, mix together the pickled ginger and scallions.
Combine the tofu and pickled ginger mixture in a large bowl.
Pour the dijon mustard mixture over the tofu and gently toss to coat.
Sprinkle the sesame seeds over the top of the tofu.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the tofu a gentle toss to redistribute the sauce.
Serve the tofu poke chilled, garnished with additional scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
